subdomain.title: Subdomain
subdomain.description: This becomes your server's permanent address and part of every username on it. Mastodon cannot change it later without breaking every follow — pick the one you want to keep.

owner_username.title: Your username
owner_username.description: Letters, numbers and underscores. This account is created for you and owns the server.

owner_email.title: Your email
owner_email.description: Used to sign in and for admin notices. The account is created already confirmed, so no email needs to arrive for you to log in.

smtp_server.title: Email server (optional)
smtp_server.description: Leave empty to run this as a one-person server. Anyone else signing up needs a confirmation email, which needs this filled in. e.g. smtp.fastmail.com

smtp_from_address.title: Send email from
smtp_from_address.description: The address invitations and confirmations appear to come from. Defaults to your email above.

storage_size.title: Storage size
storage_size.description: Mastodon caches media from every account your users follow, so this fills faster than you would expect.

yolab.description: Injected by local-api at install time; not user-editable.
